source.description:
William Liao Portrait

William Liao appears in a close-up promotional portrait, showcasing his tousled dark hair, clear complexion, and neutral expression. He wears a white shirt layered under a casual jacket against a plain light gray background.

Liao is a Taiwanese actor and writer known for roles in My Little Princess, Small & Mighty, One Night in Taipei, Brown Sugar Macchiato, Assassin Legend, Someone Like You, The Legend of Brown Sugar Chivalries, and The Stand Up. This image corresponds to his profile on The Movie Database.

source.description:
William’s Comeback Portrait

William stands against a minimalist backdrop, wearing a tailored black blazer left open to reveal his chest and a distinctive pendant necklace. His hair is styled neatly, and his gaze is steady, conveying both confidence and calm.

Following his involvement in the military draft evasion scandal earlier this year, William reunited with his former boy band Lollipop F at the Golden Bell Awards on October 17. There, he received the Reality Program Host Award and publicly thanked his family, marking a significant step in his return to the entertainment industry.
